name: wfpane
description: A live workflow pane: replaces the default Workflow progress list with a phase-by-phase graph or a timeline beside the transcript, showing each agent's state, timing, live token spend, tool calls, what it is saying, and prompt.

orientation.title: Layout
orientation.description: Which way the phases run: 'flow' across the pane, 'stack' down it, 'time' for a timeline of bars against the clock, or 'auto' to follow the pane's shape.

detailRows.title: Detail height
detailRows.description: Rows the detail strip takes when a node is selected (5 to 32), capped at half the canvas. Asked and Called sit side by side; Said takes a row of its own underneath.

paneRows.title: Pane height
paneRows.description: Rows the pane asks for while seated inline above the prompt (6 to 80). The dock beside the transcript ignores it; run /tui default to get the inline seat.

site.title: Where it draws
site.description: 'pane' beside the transcript, 'band' full width above the prompt, or 'below' in the hint line under the prompt. The footer button cycles them, '/wf pane|band|below' names one, and the choice is remembered.

bandRows.title: Band height
bandRows.description: Rows the drawing takes in the band above the prompt (8 to 40).

backdrop.title: Backdrop
backdrop.description: 'on' paints the drawing on an opaque dark ground at every seat, which is what the palette is drawn for; 'off' lets the terminal's own background show through.
